blocks.goal: Extract file-boundary inspection and chop-file selection into a cohesive utility class, reducing the public API and unrelated responsibilities of CompactableUtils.

ops.details: Move getFirstAndLastKeys and findChopFiles, preserving their signatures and visibility. The extracted class remains in the target package and retains the existing FileOperations, VolumeManager, TableConfiguration, CryptoService, FileSKVIterator, StoredTabletFile, Pair, Key, and KeyExtent dependencies.
Add the imports required by the extracted getFirstAndLastKeys and findChopFiles implementations, and remove imports no longer used by CompactableUtils after extraction.
Update all callers to use CompactableFileUtils while preserving arguments, return types, checked exceptions, and behavior.

blocks.goal: Extract compaction plugin configuration, selector execution, and compaction helper coordination into a cohesive class, reducing the general-purpose method count and implementation complexity of CompactableUtils.

ops.details: Move the compaction selector and configurer methods, newInstance, getHelper, getOverrides, and both private CompactionHelper implementations together. Preserve package visibility for package-private methods and preserve the existing nested helper behavior. Update references from CompactableUtils.newInstance, CompactableUtils.selectFiles, and computeOverrides to the extracted class within the moved implementation.

Add all imports required by the extracted compaction plugin implementation, including plugin, compaction, summary, configuration, metadata, and Hadoop types. Remove imports from CompactableUtils that are no longer referenced after extraction.

Update CompactableImpl and any other callers to use CompactableCompactionUtils. In CompactableUtils.compact, replace the call to getOverrides with CompactableCompactionUtils.getOverrides. Preserve method signatures and package-level accessibility.

blocks.goal: Reduce the remaining orchestration responsibility of CompactableUtils by delegating compaction override resolution to the extracted compaction utility.

ops.details: Replace the direct dependency on the extracted getOverrides implementation in CompactableUtils.compact with CompactableCompactionUtils.getOverrides, leaving CompactableUtils responsible only for FileCompactor construction, compaction execution, and bringing files online.
Remove imports used exclusively by the extracted compaction plugin logic and retain only imports required by compact, bringOnline, and the remaining class members.
